questions.q: What does 'thou art my bone and my flesh' mean?
questions.explain: Abimelech used the same phrase with his mother's brethren (Judges 9:1-2).

questions.q: How long did Jacob serve Laban in all for his wives?
questions.explain: Seven years for Rachel seemed but a few days; deceived, he served another seven (1 Esdras 4:25-26).

questions.q: What lesson does the class draw from Jacob favouring Rachel for her beauty?
choices: Always marry the more beautiful sister
Beauty is a sign of righteousness
Favour is deceitful and beauty is vain; a woman that feareth the Lord shall be praised
questions.explain: Do not be hasty to credit somebody for their outward appearance (Ecclesiasticus 11:2; Proverbs 31:30).

questions.q: When the Lord saw Leah was hated, what did He do?
choices: He gave her to another man
